parts.label: (b)
parts.part_stem: The radius of a small sphere is determined from a measurement of the volume of the sphere. The sphere is submerged in water, displacing some of the water into a measuring cylinder as shown in Fig. 1.1. Fig. 1.1 (not to scale) shows a sphere submerged in water with displaced water collected in a measuring cylinder. The measured volume of displaced water is $(28.0 \pm 0.5)\,\mathrm{cm^3}$. Calculate:

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.text: the radius, in cm, of the sphere

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text: the percentage uncertainty in the radius of the sphere.

marking_points.text: vector has direction (and scalar does not have direction)
